title: Fandango: method attributed to BleepingComputer, not to Fandango's notice
what_changed: The record said Fandango's notice described card-skimming code that captured payment details and titled it 'hackers stole'. Fandango's own notice on oag.ca.gov, read in full, says an unauthorized party could access payment card information for certain checkout-page transactions from October 8-11, 2026, and does not describe the method. The title and summary now follow the notice; card skimming is attributed to BleepingComputer.
